sources.title: Permutation mean and centered frame-count derivation
sources.details: For nonempty T vectors and bijection pi, (1/T)sum_j x[pi(j)]=(1/T)sum_i x[i]. Reverse pi(j)=T-1-j retains same multiset. Applied after extraction, not to a newly recomputed reversed waveform. Each0.1s tone has1600 samples;3200 concatenated; centered STFT pad200 each side yields1+floor((3600-400)/160)=21 frames;real FFT400 yields201 bins;16-band bank then transpose->[21,16];mean(0)->[16]. Float32 tolerance abs(a-b)<=1e-8+1e-5*abs(b) distinguishes approximate equality from the exact real-arithmetic identity.
